contract: Members who have chosen a plan can apply one discount code in the receipt, see its deduction, note and Remove on a "Discount" line above a lower first payment, and carry that payment to the success page.

loading.evidence: story components-discountcode--applying (aria-busy, focus kept on Apply, second press and Enter emit nothing, field keeps text); unit DiscountCode.test.ts › emits nothing while applying; api.test.ts › answers after 600 ms, can be cancelled; e2e discount-code.spec.ts › a failed check offers a retry (AC 9) (aria-busy during the retry)

empty.evidence: story components-discountcode--empty-submit (message, aria-invalid, announced, no apply event); unit DiscountCode.test.ts › shows the empty message and emits nothing for an empty or blank field. The receipt's own no-plan-yet state: components-receipt--empty, components-receipt--club-only; e2e › the field appears once the plan has a price (AC 1)

error.evidence: stories components-discountcode--network-error, --invalid, --expired, --not-eligible, --no-longer-applies, --kept-on-error; unit discount.test.ts (checkCode, rejectionMessage, nextApplied), api.test.ts › fails with ?mock=code-error; e2e › an unknown code shows the message (AC 5), a failed check offers a retry (AC 9), a rejected new code keeps the applied one (AC 13), a plan change drops a code that no longer applies (AC 14)

partial.reason: A code is checked as a whole: one answer, applied in full or not at all. Nothing loads in parts.

success.evidence: stories components-discountcode--applied (field emptied, focus on Apply, announcement), components-discountapplied--default (note, Remove named "Remove code TEST-10", emits remove by click, Enter, Space), components-discountapplied--narrow (Remove wraps under the note, no overflow, Tab and Enter), components-receiptline--deduction ("−€2", read "€2 off"), components-receipt--with-discount (Tab Remove → field → Apply → referral); unit discount.test.ts, pricing.test.ts, ReceiptLine.test.ts, DiscountApplied.test.ts; e2e › a valid code lowers the total (AC 2, 10), removing the code restores the total (AC 11), a new code replaces the applied one (AC 12), the discount reaches the success page (AC 16), the referral code leaves the discounted total alone (AC 20)

permission.reason: The product has no accounts or roles (docs/spec.md §7), so every visitor may enter a code. Codes limited to some plans are covered by the not-eligible error.

accessibility.evidence: axe (error level) clean on every story and on the DiscountCode, DiscountApplied, TextField, ReceiptLine and Receipt Matrix stories in all 6 themes; e2e a11y.spec.ts axe on step 3 with the field in 6 themes; pnpm contrast 210/210. Keyboard: DiscountCode Keyboard story (Tab to field, Enter applies with focus kept, Tab to Apply, Space), TextField WithAction (input → action, description unchanged), Receipt WithDiscount (Remove → field → Apply → referral), DiscountApplied Default (Tab, Enter, Space); e2e focus on Apply after applying, focus into the field after Remove. Announcements: one polite role=status in DiscountCode, mounted from the first render, checked for applied, replaced, kept, error, no-longer-applies and removed in e2e; no role=alert. Success and errors always carry an icon and words.

responsive.evidence: visual tests/visual/app.spec.ts › step-3-duration-discount, step-4-details-discount, step-5-verify-discount, success-discount (arden-north, Home club, 2 years, TEST-10 applied; success shows First payment €20) in all 6 themes at 375 and 1280; e2e › the field and Apply share a row at 375 px and wrap at 320 px without overflow (AC 19, 21) (no horizontal scroll at either width); story components-discountapplied--narrow and its Matrix row: Remove wraps under the note below 155 px, which the 236 px discount line at 320 px reaches with text at 200 %
